purpose: Qualify vLLM #64830 at source level after its separate metadata-only Development/Train overlap review found no direct identity/family overlap. This protocol authorizes no split assignment or model exposure.
hypothesis: The exact pre-merge vLLM source fails the regression assertions added by #64830, one incorrect mutant of the fixed source is rejected, and the exact merged source passes the same assertions under an isolated CPU-only harness.

candidate.title_from_frozen_metadata: [Config] Move V2-only checks into V1 model runner unsupported features
candidate.family_hypothesis: V1 model-runner configuration handling for checks described as V2-only unsupported features.

source_identity_gates: Verify repository identity, exact Git commit objects, base ancestry, PR head, merge commit, and license after this protocol is committed and pushed.
Use only the frozen candidate and test paths; do not inspect PR discussion or unrelated paths.
If the expected changed paths or revisions do not match the frozen metadata, stop without adapting the candidate selection.
qualification_plan.test_overlay: After source access, extract only PR-added or PR-modified regression tests from the two frozen test paths into a trusted overlay. Do not edit assertions. If no targeted regression exists, or it requires accelerator, network, external service, or full-server execution, stop unqualified.

arms.name: baseline
arms.test_overlay: Exact targeted regression tests and support bytes from the frozen PR merge revision, unchanged.

arms.name: wrong-mutant
arms.source_mutation: Construct one minimal incorrect mutation of the specific behavior changed by #64830. Bind the exact diff and hash in a source-access execution addendum before running any candidate test. The mutant must restore at least one baseline failure.

arms.name: upstream-fixed
arms.test_overlay: The same exact tests, support files, and harness as baseline and wrong-mutant.

required_outcomes.baseline: Every targeted regression fails at its intended behavioral assertion, with no import/collection error, skip, timeout, or unrelated failure.
required_outcomes.wrong_mutant: The identical targeted cases reject the incorrect mutant at their intended assertions.
required_outcomes.upstream_fixed: Every targeted regression passes with no skip or unrelated failure.
required_outcomes.all_arms: Hashes, repository identity, grader boundary, sandbox, and resource limits match the execution addendum.

execution_addendum_required_before_any_t: exact test IDs and test/support hashes
exact source file hashes for each arm

isolation.platform: macOS Apple Silicon local CPU only; do not use a paid or remote service.
isolation.sandbox: Default-deny macOS Seatbelt, no network, source checkout read-only, writes restricted to a fresh arm-specific evidence directory.
isolation.retry_rule: Every arm invocation is consumed. A retry requires a new hash-bound addendum frozen before retry.

qualification_decision_rule: QUALIFIED_SOURCE_LEVEL only if all identity, baseline, wrong-mutant, upstream-fixed, isolation, and resource gates pass. Otherwise retain the complete failure and keep the task unqualified.
limitations: A source qualification result is not a model repair or model-capability result.
Public pretraining exposure remains UNKNOWN even if all source-level gates pass.
Source qualification does not assign the task to Development and authorizes no inference or training.
stop_rules: Do not access candidate PR body, discussions, unrelated patches, or any Held-Out task or artifact.
Do not execute candidate tests until an execution addendum has been committed and pushed.
Do not continue if the exact source, license, CPU feasibility, or isolation gate fails.
Do not substitute another task under this protocol.
Keep #64830 UNQUALIFIED and UNASSIGNED until a separately frozen exposure assignment exists.
